mapper.insert: insert into cart (user_id, sku_id) values (#{userId}, #{skuId}) on duplicate key update update_time = current_timestamp
mapper.update: UPDATE spu SET cart_add_cnt = cart_add_cnt + 1 WHERE id = #{spuId}
mapper.select: SELECT spu_id FROM sku WHERE id = #{skuId}
SELECT s.status FROM sku k INNER JOIN spu s ON k.spu_id = s.id WHERE k.id = #{skuId}
select id, user_id, sku_id, create_time, update_time from cart where user_id = #{userId} order by update_time desc, create_time desc

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.sku_id, c.create_time, c.update_time, s.spu_id, s.specs, s.price, s.stock, p.title, p.intro, p.status, (SELECT img_url FROM spu_preview_img WHERE spu_id = s.spu_id ORDER BY sort ASC LIMIT 1) as preview_image, p.mini_program_appid, p.mini_program_path, p.micro_shop_appid, p.micro_shop_product_id FROM cart c INNER JOIN sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id INNER JOIN spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.sku_id, c.create_time, c.update_time, s.spu_id, s.specs, s.price, s.stock, p.title, p.intro, p.status, (SELECT img_url FROM spu_preview_img WHERE spu_id = s.spu_id ORDER BY sort ASC LIMIT 1) as preview_image, p.mini_program_appid, p.mini_program_path, p.micro_shop_appid, p.micro_shop_product_id FROM cart c INNER JOIN sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id INNER JOIN spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(1) from cart where user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, sku_id, create_time, update_time from cart order by update_time desc, create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
